breeds.name: Golden Retriever
breeds.careGuide: Requires daily exercise, weekly brushing, and regular mental stimulation.
breeds.funFact: They have water-resistant double coats and webbed feet.

breeds.name: German Shepherd
breeds.careGuide: Needs consistent obedience training, heavy physical activation, and early socialization.
breeds.funFact: They are highly popular as working dogs.

breeds.name: French Bulldog
breeds.careGuide: Keep cool in hot weather due to breathing sensitivity. Low exercise requirements.
breeds.funFact: They cannot swim due to their squat frame.

breeds.name: Persian Cat
breeds.careGuide: Requires daily grooming to prevent coat mats. Keep indoors.
breeds.funFact: They have one of the oldest breed records in the world.

breeds.name: Maine Coon
breeds.careGuide: Need space to grow and run. Brush their thick shaggy coat twice weekly.
breeds.funFact: They are well-adapted for harsh climates.

breeds.name: Siamese Cat
breeds.careGuide: Thrives on human companionship, very active and requires interactive toys.
breeds.funFact: Siamese kittens are born completely white.

breeds.name: Budgerigar (Parakeet)
breeds.careGuide: Needs flight cages and daily out-of-cage supervised time.

breeds.name: Cockatiel
breeds.careGuide: Place cage in active living room. Provide chewing toys.
breeds.funFact: Their crest position is a mood indicator.
